summary: Event-dense Tuesday: the two-day Fed meeting opens today (decision Wed 10-28), three mega-caps report this week, and a large block of names have estimated earnings inside 5 trading days (EXLS, INCY, LOGI today; CALX, CVS, GRMN, RRC 10-28; AAPL, BDC, BJRI, HWM, LNG 10-29; CLX, IDXX 11-02 at the edge). Company news is otherwise thin: DORM reported after the close 10-26 (adj EPS beat, sales slight miss, FY sales guide below estimate), DoorDash is reported in advanced talks to buy Instacart for about $17B (possibly this week), and Apple adds a display-defect replacement program for the iPhone Duo as a new negative against strong demand. Dates are last-year-plus-364-day estimates and approximate; trading-day counts below start from today, 10-27. Per L2 every symbol in the events file is covered, and per the news_memory thread this continues RRC (EQT merger), DORM (flagged high 10-23, now resolved), TPR (third PT cut) and the AI-bubble/Fed/oil index backdrop.
